status: Hypothetical sensitivities; none of the operational growth, mix, absorption, days or cost assumptions below are measured company inputs.
baseline_note: Q3 2026 output >200,000; multiplying the threshold by four gives a deliberately conservative normalization, not exact output or a seasonally adjusted forecast. Formula can be rerun with a verified baseline.

cases.name: Existing-footprint ramp
cases.capital: No incremental building capex assumed; hiring, training, maintenance, technology and logistics still require spending.
cases.interpretation: Net staffing/process gains at Q3 footprint, stable repair intensity; additional planned projects deliberately excluded to isolate this route.

cases.name: Expansion-supported
cases.capital: Three buildouts $90–105m plus six hypothetical integrations $12–18m; gross full-project budgets, not remaining capex or annual company capex guidance.
cases.interpretation: 2027 first-year realization=half year open x60% productive rate. Higher 2028–29 ramp is assumed; constant vehicle mix.

cases.name: Operational downside
cases.capital: Three buildouts still require $90–105m gross project budgets; integrations deferred. Hiring and rework costs could be higher, unquantified.
cases.interpretation: Productive resources improve slowly; average repair labor requirement is 10% above baseline. Assumes labor/repair is bottleneck; not universally applicable.

cases.name: Demand/economic downside
cases.capital: Same potential project commitments as expansion case; economics worsen through idle capacity or discounting. Rational production curtailment needed.
cases.interpretation: Absorbable sales fall progressively below feasible production at acceptable economics. Unabsorbed production is an alert, not a forecast of intentional multi-year accumulation.
